game_concept: A speed quiz set in Eldritch Ruins – Ritual Pool, a still ritual pool: the tomb cartographer must handle echo phantoms while practicing lists. Core idea – Duplicate Sweep: Remove repeated items from a list of ancient keys while keeping the order.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Ritual Pool: a still ritual pool
core_gameplay_loop: In Ritual Pool, repeat each round: Remove repeated items from a list of ancient keys while keeping the order. Each round, a new ancient keys challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the clean_list value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 440 points of ancient keys by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 440, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 7 (applied tier): Duplicate Sweep
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
